title: Trove habit
description: One line of habits/<source>/habits.jsonl: a current habit definition, rewritten whole per sync. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

id.description: source-native habit id, the snapshot key (Way of Life: a stable hash of the habit name)

schedule.description: cadence, verbatim from the source: an RRULE, "daily", "weekly", "Mon,Wed,Fri" — raw, not interpreted

goal.description: per-period target for a measurable habit (8 glasses, 30 minutes)

unit.description: the unit goal is counted in ("Glass", "min", "page")

color.description: display color, where the source has one

archived.description: habit is archived / paused / no longer active

created.description: RFC3339 local time the habit was created

modified.description: RFC3339 local time the habit was last modified

extra.description: everything source-specific (streak counts, RPG XP/level/gold, reminders, icon, target days, …)
